verdicts.rationale: The only flagged divergences are constitution-excluded or curator process-talk. The Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis 'deer state' is an explicitly Stamina-consuming movement transformation (stamina and movement are out of scope by constitution), and the charged-attack frames deliberately model the damaging Spiritcall Prayer form instead — a reasonable approximation, not a decision-relevant divergence. The deerFrames/two-state-cooldown handling and the EM-scaling CD reduction are schema-representation decisions for a reviewer, and the missing plunge frames are an unavailable-data gap on an out-of-rotation surface. Nothing here misleads a player planning a damage/buff rotation.
rubricRefs: Out of scope by constitution: stamina, movement
Purpose test: would a player be misled by the timeline

groundedIn.claim: The charged attack is a Stamina-consuming movement transformation (the deer state).
groundedIn.quote: Lauma undergoes Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis, transforming into an envoy of the tranquil forest and consuming Stamina to charge forward for up to 10s.

groundedIn.claim: The modeled charge frames record the damaging Spiritcall Prayer form, not the deer state.
groundedIn.quote: chargeFrames here records Spiritcall Prayer only — the damaging CA form active while Spirit Envoy CD is active. Reviewer to decide schema representation for deerFrames and the two-state cooldown mechanic.

groundedIn.claim: Plunge frames are unavailable / a data gap.
groundedIn.quote: No plunge.go in gcsim character dir — plungeFrames not available.

verdicts.rationale: The C1 heal is authored and renders. Its only real gap is the missing 20s Threads-of-Life gate, so the heal fires on any Lunar-Bloom — but the curator note itself confirms the gate is auto-fulfilled by the opening E/Q in canonical rotations, and the skill (CD 12s) and burst (CD 15s) each re-open the 20s window, so the over-render never visibly manifests. Wiring a state gate would add complexity with zero displayed effect for real rotations. The other half of C1 — reduced Spirit Envoy Stamina cost and an extended deer-state duration — is stamina/movement, constitution-excluded. No decision-relevant divergence to repair.
rubricRefs: Out of scope by constitution: stamina, movement
Optimistic/auto-fulfilling gate: assumption holds in canonical rotations

groundedIn.claim: The authored heal has no 20s-window condition, so it fires on any Lunar-Bloom in the rotation.
groundedIn.quote: The 20s c1Key gate (status applied on E or Q cast) isn't expressed as a condition — the heal will fire on any Lunar-Bloom in the rotation.

groundedIn.claim: The 20s gate is auto-fulfilled by the opening E/Q in canonical rotations, so the over-render does not manifest in practice.
groundedIn.quote: In canonical Lauma rotations the gate is auto-fulfilled by the opening E/Q.

groundedIn.claim: The other half of C1 is reduced Spirit Envoy Stamina cost and an extended deer-state duration (movement/stamina).
groundedIn.quote: the Stamina cost for Lauma's Spirit Envoy Form will be reduced by 40%, and its Max Duration will be extended by 5s.

groundedIn.claim: The skill re-opens the 20s window every 12s.
groundedIn.quote: After Lauma uses her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko or her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon, she will gain Threads of Life for 20s.
